_readme: Edit this file to change what the site pulls. google_news entries are Google News RSS searches (query syntax = Google News search). google_alerts entries are RSS URLs from google.com/alerts (create an alert, Show options, Deliver to: RSS feed, then copy the feed link). Lines starting with # are ignored.

google_news.name: Data center announced
google_news.query: "data center" (announces OR announced OR plans OR proposed OR unveils) when:7d

google_news.name: Data center construction
google_news.query: "data center" (construction OR "breaks ground" OR groundbreaking OR opens) when:7d

google_news.name: AI and hyperscale
google_news.query: ("AI data center" OR "hyperscale data center" OR "data center campus") when:7d

google_news.name: Data center power
google_news.query: "data center" (power OR grid OR megawatt OR gigawatt OR nuclear OR utility) when:7d

google_news.name: Data center policy
google_news.query: "data center" (zoning OR council OR moratorium OR residents OR "tax breaks") when:7d
